issues.reason: Coordination & plurals states the default without restricting it to subjects or objects — coordinated noun phrases "replicate the whole predication once per conjunct" — and reserves the one-event/many-role-atoms shape for reciprocal/aggregate predicates or a bare "together"/"jointly"; neither licenses two Location atoms on one performing, which additionally places a single performing in two disjoint settings.

notes: I do not confirm the reviewer's coverage gap: the distributive default is stated for coordinated noun phrases generally, so the oblique case is decided by the rule text and only the illustration is missing.
